folder_structure.description: E5-S5 / F172-F177 are proven by pytest, not HTTP: architecture tests for published-rule immutability (F172), approved-case immutability (F173), override audit for band reassignment (F174), no upward imports (F175), UPDATE and DELETE rejected on every append-only table (F176), end-to-end logs free of plaintext PII (F177). E5-S1 F155/F156 (50-case fixture, no float in metrics) and E5-S3 F165 (p95 under 500 ms on 1,000 cases) are also pytest checks. E5-S4 dashboard features F167-F171 are UI and out of scope for this contract.
